'''Carrion birds''' were a species of [[Diet/Legends|carrion]] [[Bird/Legends|birds]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. They were known to be scavengers, and were seen feasting on [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] bodies after the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]].
